purpose: Remplacer les gates de réception terrain par une décision de couverture théorique documentée pour les mémoires dont la fréquence, le mode et l'état courant sont déjà publiquement vérifiés.

minimum_requirements: current authoritative or operator source verifies the station as active or operational
candidate RF and mode are publicly resolved
target-area path is theoretically plausible from published geometry, operator range or an equivalent documented propagation model
theoretical status is disclosed and must not be described as measured reception
not_sufficient: frequency inferred from an unresolved listing
station currently marked maintenance, stopped or unavailable by its operator
stale secondary frequency overriding a current authoritative source

reference_point.name: Mortain
reference_point.role: representative reference point for Mortain-Bocage coverage theory
reference_point.limitations: A single representative point does not model every location, building, antenna or terrain obstruction inside Mortain-Bocage.

propagation_methods.great_circle_distance: haversine on WGS84-like spherical Earth approximation

endpoint_elevation_envelope.limitations: Does not model terrain profile, clutter, diffraction, antenna pattern, receiver sensitivity or fading.

free_space_path_loss.limitations: Not a received-signal prediction without transmitter EIRP, antenna system and obstruction losses.
